intended_use: One continuous grouped garden panorama for all non-road store perimeter edges.
ground_contact: Irregular planting base near y=700px; runtime baseline uses x=100..2070px at y=700px.
placement: World z=0, 2.43m outside the wall, behind wall/paving occlusion; uniformly fitted to edge-specific 12m, 18m, or 20m baselines.

generation.prompt_summary: Wide transparent group of varied upright leafy trees, dense layered shrubs and a continuous small pink/white flower bed; no buildings, streets, signs, or background.

review: Actual Godot 4.7.2 captures at 12x10, 16x12, 20x16, and panned/zoomed 20x16 confirm wall occlusion, ground anchoring and continuous perimeter coverage. Bright edge pixels are visible in isolated image inspection but not prominent at whole-game-scene scale. Kept as a runtime candidate, pending user visual approval and broader performance review.
